---
title: "ECEC_harmonize"
output: html_document
---

```{r Step 1, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# ECEC BENEFITS: Initial inspection
# ============================================================

ecec_benefits <- read_csv(
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_ECEC",
    "ecec_benefits_industry_annual_2004_2024.csv"
  )
)

# Basic structure
glimpse(ecec_benefits)

# Industries
ecec_benefits %>%
  distinct(
    industry_code,
    industry
  ) %>%
  arrange(industry_code)

# Benefit categories
ecec_benefits %>%
  distinct(
    estimate_code,
    benefit
  ) %>%
  arrange(estimate_code)

# Coverage by industry
ecec_benefits %>%
  group_by(
    industry_code,
    industry
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    first_year = min(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_years = n_distinct(year),
    n_benefits = n_distinct(benefit),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check for duplicates
ecec_benefits %>%
  count(
    year,
    industry_code,
    estimate_code
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

# ============================================================
# ECEC: Correct industry-year benefit measures
# ============================================================

ecec_benefits_final <- ecec_benefits %>%
  
  # Keep the dimensions needed for the final industry-year file
  select(
    year,
    industry_code,
    industry,
    estimate_code,
    benefit,
    benefit_cost_per_hour
  ) %>%
  
  # Put each benefit category into its own column.
  # estimate_code is deliberately NOT included in the
  # identifier because each benefit is already identified
  # by the benefit variable.
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(
      year,
      industry_code,
      industry
    ),
    names_from = benefit,
    values_from = benefit_cost_per_hour
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Original ECEC measures
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    benefits_total =
      `Total benefits`,
    
    benefits_paid_leave =
      `Paid leave`,
    
    benefits_insurance =
      Insurance,
    
    benefits_health =
      `Health insurance`,
    
    benefits_retirement =
      `Retirement and savings`,
    
    benefits_required =
      `Legally required benefits`,
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Composite measures
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    # Non-required benefits:
    # paid leave + insurance + retirement
    benefits_nonrequired =
      benefits_paid_leave +
      benefits_insurance +
      benefits_retirement,
    
    # Economic-security benefits:
    # health insurance + retirement
    benefits_security =
      benefits_health +
      benefits_retirement
  )

glimpse(ecec_benefits_final)

ecec_benefits_final %>%
  select(
    year,
    industry_code,
    industry,
    benefits_total,
    benefits_paid_leave,
    benefits_insurance,
    benefits_health,
    benefits_retirement,
    benefits_required,
    benefits_nonrequired,
    benefits_security
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)


ecec_benefits_final %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    missing_total = sum(is.na(benefits_total)),
    missing_nonrequired = sum(is.na(benefits_nonrequired)),
    missing_security = sum(is.na(benefits_security))
  )


ecec_benefits_final






# ============================================================
# ECEC: Construct benefit measures
# ============================================================

ecec_benefits_final <- ecec_benefits_wide %>%
  mutate(
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Original ECEC components
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    benefits_total = `Total benefits`,
    
    benefits_paid_leave = `Paid leave`,
    
    benefits_insurance = Insurance,
    
    benefits_health = `Health insurance`,
    
    benefits_retirement = `Retirement and savings`,
    
    benefits_required = `Legally required benefits`,
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Composite benefit measures
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    # Non-required employer benefits
    benefits_nonrequired =
      benefits_paid_leave +
      benefits_insurance +
      benefits_retirement,
    
    # Benefits most directly related to economic security
    benefits_security =
      benefits_health +
      benefits_retirement
  )


# ============================================================
# ECEC benefit diagnostics
# ============================================================

#Health Insurance Avaiability
ecec_benefits %>% 
  group_by( 
    industry_code, industry ) %>% 
  summarise( 
    n_health_observations = sum( 
      benefit == "Health insurance" & !is.na(benefit_cost_per_hour) 
      ), 
    .groups = "drop" ) %>% 
  filter(
    n_health_observations == 0 ) %>% 
  arrange( industry_code 
           )


ecec_benefits %>% 
  filter( 
    benefit == "Health insurance" ) %>% 
  mutate( 
    health_available = !is.na(benefit_cost_per_hour) 
    ) %>% 
  select( 
    year, industry_code, industry, health_available 
    ) %>% 
  pivot_wider( 
    names_from = year, values_from = health_available ) %>% 
  arrange( 
    industry_code 
    )


insurance_availability <- ecec_benefits %>% 
  filter( benefit == "Insurance" 
          ) %>% 
  group_by( 
    industry_code, industry 
    ) %>% 
  summarise( 
    n_available = sum(!is.na(benefit_cost_per_hour)), n_years = n_distinct(year), first_year = min(year[!is.na(benefit_cost_per_hour)]), last_year = max(year[!is.na(benefit_cost_per_hour)]), .groups = "drop" ) %>% 
  mutate( complete_coverage = n_available == n_years ) %>% 
  arrange(industry_code) 

insurance_availability


ecec_benefits_final %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_industries = n_distinct(industry_code),
    min_year = min(year),
    max_year = max(year),
    
    missing_total =
      sum(is.na(benefits_total)),
    
    missing_nonrequired =
      sum(is.na(benefits_nonrequired)),
    
    missing_security =
      sum(is.na(benefits_security))
  )



ecec_benefits_final %>%
  summarise(
    
    total_median =
      median(benefits_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    nonrequired_median =
      median(benefits_nonrequired, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    security_median =
      median(benefits_security, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    total_min =
      min(benefits_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    total_max =
      max(benefits_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    nonrequired_min =
      min(benefits_nonrequired, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    nonrequired_max =
      max(benefits_nonrequired, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


ecec_benefits_final <- ecec_benefits_final %>% mutate( benefits_nonrequired = benefits_paid_leave + benefits_insurance + benefits_retirement, benefits_security = benefits_insurance + benefits_retirement )


# ============================================================
# Finalize ECEC benefits measures
# ============================================================

ecec_benefits_final <- ecec_benefits_final %>%
  mutate(
    
    # Primary non-required benefits measure
    benefits_nonrequired =
      benefits_paid_leave +
      benefits_insurance +
      benefits_retirement,
    
    # Security-oriented benefits measure
    # Uses aggregate insurance because it is consistently
    # available across all industries.
    benefits_security =
      benefits_insurance +
      benefits_retirement
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Final diagnostic checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecec_benefits_final %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_industries = n_distinct(industry_code),
    first_year = min(year),
    last_year = max(year),
    missing_nonrequired = sum(is.na(benefits_nonrequired)),
    missing_security = sum(is.na(benefits_security))
  )


# Confirm one row per industry-year
ecec_benefits_final %>%
  count(year, industry_code) %>%
  filter(n > 1)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save final ECEC dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  ecec_benefits_final,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_ECEC",
    "ecec_benefits_industry_final_2004_2024.rds"
  )
)

write_csv(
  ecec_benefits_final,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_ECEC",
    "ecec_benefits_industry_final_2004_2024.csv"
  )
)


```
